<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of 193.0789 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈13 % M+1 and ≈33 % M+2) indicates the presence of ~12 carbons and a single chlorine atom. A formula that matches the exact mass within a few ppm is C₁₂H₁₄Cl (no oxygens). Following the required format CxHyOzX, the molecular formula is C12H14O0Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H14O0Cl</final_answer>
